# nod

> nod is a free, MIT-licensed, suckless-style notification daemon for X11, written in C11 by Matteo Merola. It implements the Desktop Notifications Specification 1.2 over native D-Bus.

nod renders notifications as folding cards using CUI and SDL3. Features include hover-to-unfold stacks, action buttons, animated entrance and exit, swipe dismissal, focused-monitor selection with XRandR, Xresources colors and fonts with live reload, compile-time configuration in config.h, scheduled do not disturb, app muting, an XEmbed tray toggle, and nod-dnd / nod-send scripts.

nod targets X11, not Wayland. It does not provide icons, markup, sounds, notification history, or a runtime configuration file. DND discards incoming notifications, including critical ones; it does not queue them.
